pr.title: Support executable references to container-network endpoints
pr.author: danegsta

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: VS Code extension Blazor browser debugger E2E tests timed out waiting for a WASM root session on Linux. The PR only changes Aspire.Hosting DCP/executable/container-network code (ResourceExtensions.cs, ContainerCreator.cs, ContainerNetworkEndpointProvisioner.cs, DcpExecutor.cs, ExecutableCreator.cs, etc.) with no changes to the VS Code extension or its Blazor debugger E2E harness. This matches a previously known recurring flaky pattern (issue #20184).
